    counts = np.asarray(counts, dtype=np.float64)
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts must be finite")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts must be nonnegative")
    cell_norms = np.sqrt(np.sum(counts ** 2, axis=1))
    if (cell_norms == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("all-zero rows are not allowed")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells-1")

    def matvec(v):
        w = v / cell_norms
        temp = counts.T @ w
        z = counts @ temp
        result = z / cell_norms
        return result

    shape = (n_cells, n_cells)
    dtype = np.float64
    S = LinearOperator(shape, matvec=matvec, rmatvec=matvec, dtype=dtype)

    np.random.seed(random_state)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(S, k=n_components, which='LA', return_eigenvectors=True)

    idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
